LockTied sharing rules

Taynium · Last updated: 17 October 2026

Only connect with someone who agrees to hear from you. Share content you own or have permission to use.

What is prohibited

Do not share illegal content, threats, harassment, hateful abuse, non-consensual intimate content or unwanted sexual content. Child sexual abuse or exploitation material is strictly prohibited. Do not use LockTied to groom, exploit or endanger children.

Consent and control

Stop if the other person asks. Settings → Disconnect phones stops their access; they cannot send again unless you choose to connect again. Anyone who sees your lock screen may see its artwork. Sharing uses Firebase and is not end-to-end encrypted.

Report a concern

Use Settings → Report a concern, or email Prioritydesk.app@outlook.com. Describe what happened and when. Do not attach illegal or sensitive imagery. Taynium reviews reports and may restrict or remove access. Contact local emergency services if someone is in immediate danger.

In the app, selecting Agree means you accept these rules. Read our privacy policy for how data is processed.
